content.title: How to watch Hawaii vs. Arkansas men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 19
content.text: The No. 4 Arkansas Razorbacks (26-8) and the No. 13 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors (24-8) square off on Thursday for a spot in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. The first-round matchup starts at 4:25 p.m. ET.How to watch Hawaii Rainbow Warriors vs. Arkansas Razorbacks Venue: Moda Center Time: 4:25 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Arkansas connects on 8.3 three-pointers per game (131st in college basketball), while its opponents have made 7.7 on average. Hawaii puts up 79.6 points per game (89th in college basketball) while allowing 69.7 per outing (67th in college basketball). It has a +317 scoring differential and outscores opponents by 9.9 points per game. Hawaii hits 7.4 three-pointers per game (209th in college basketball) at a 31.5% rate (312th in college basketball), compared to the 5.9 per game its opponents make, at a 30.4% rate.
